title: RLF Pipeline State
description: Canonical state file for the RLF multi-agent pipeline. Lives at the repo root as state.json. Read and written ONLY by the Orchestrator (Agent 00). Other agents read it but never write it.

schema_version.description: Version of this state schema. Bump only with a dedicated PR.

pipeline_id.description: Short kebab-case ID for this artifact's pipeline run (e.g., 'student-checklist-v1', 'tt-paper-revision-2026-05').

artifact_type.description: What kind of artifact is being produced. Drives Critic rubric weighting.

current_stage.description: Where the pipeline currently is. Updated by Orchestrator after each routing decision.

target_version.description: Public-facing semver of the artifact being produced (e.g., 'v1.1' or 'v2.0.0'). Not the iteration number.

iteration.description: How many Critic↔Reviser cycles have completed for the current target_version.

iteration_max.description: Hard cap on Critic↔Reviser cycles. Reaching this triggers Finalist with escalation_reason='iter_max'.

score_threshold.description: Minimum Critic total_score required to skip the Reviser loop. Default 90.

latest_draft.description: Path to the most recent draft file.

latest_review.description: Path to the most recent Critic JSON output.

latest_final.description: Path to the most recent Finalist output.

latest_verification.description: Path to the most recent Verifier report.

latest_total_score.description: Most recent Critic total_score. Set ONLY by Orchestrator after reading the Critic's review.json.

escalation_reason.description: Why the pipeline took an exceptional path, if any.

evidence_ref.description: Path to a file or PR comment evidencing the failure.

failure_log.description: Append-only list of failures captured during the run. Used for post-mortem and rubric calibration.

reason.description: One-sentence justification citing an Orchestrator rule number where applicable.

human_gates.description: Tracks human approval gates. Set by Orchestrator based on PR events.

publish_authorized.description: Separate gate: even after PR approval, the human must explicitly authorize the Publisher run (post a comment like '/rlf publish' on the PR).
